info.name: Digital Employee API v2
info.description:
Complete & updated Postman collection for the Digital Employee ASP.NET Core API.

--- SWAGGER (same host as baseUrl; path /swagger only in browser) ---
IIS Express: http://localhost:9875/swagger/index.html  |  https://localhost:44361/swagger/index.html
Kestrel: http://localhost:5157/swagger/index.html

--- BASE URL ---
Default: http://localhost:9875 (IIS Express HTTP). Also: https://localhost:44361 (IIS HTTPS), http://localhost:5157 (Kestrel).
TROUBLESHOOTING: Postman Environment OVERRIDES collection variables — set baseUrl there or No Environment. Save after edits.

--- RECOMMENDED TEST FLOW ---
1. Register Admin   → POST /api/Auth/register-admin   (no token needed)
2. Register Owner   → POST /api/Auth/register-owner   (no token needed)
3. Login as Owner   → POST /api/Auth/login            (token auto-saved)
4. Create Business  → POST /api/Business              (save businessId)
5. Login as Admin   → POST /api/Auth/login            (token auto-saved)
6. Register Agent   → POST /api/Auth/register         (requires businessId)
7. Create Menu Category → POST /api/MenuCategory
8. Create Menu Item     → POST /api/MenuItem
9. Create Customer      → POST /api/Customer
10. Create Order        → POST /api/Order

--- ROLES ---
- Admin:  Full system access
- Owner:  Manage their own business
- Agent:  Handle tickets, chat, orders (default role for /register)
- User:   Reserved (not used in normal registration flow)

--- AUTH ---
All protected endpoints use Bearer token from {{token}} variable.
Public endpoints have auth set to noauth.

Token, userId, and businessId are auto-saved to collection variables.

item.name: Get Dashboard Overview (one call, all sections)

exec: console.log('Sections -> insights:', !!j.generalInsights, '| channels:', (j.channelDistribution && j.channelDistribution.channels ? j.channelDistribution.channels.length : 0), '| products:', (j.topProducts ? j.topProducts.length : 0), '| leads:', (j.customerLeads ? j.customerLeads.length : 0));

query.description: Global default for any section param left out. Allowed: today | 7d | 30d | all | custom
General insights window. Allowed: today | 7d | 30d | custom
Channel distribution. Allowed: today | 7d | 30d | all | custom
Sentiment analysis. Allowed: today | 7d | 30d | all | custom
Top products window. Allowed: today | 7d | 30d | all | custom
Customer leads window. Allowed: today | 7d | 30d | all | custom
Required when any period=custom. ISO date (UTC), inclusive start.
Required when any period=custom. ISO date (UTC), inclusive end. Must be >= customFrom.

request.description:
Single endpoint that returns the entire dashboard in one call: general insights (with % change), channel distribution, sentiment analysis, revenue trend, top products, recent alerts, and customer leads.

Each section can be filtered independently; any section param left out falls back to 'period' (default 30d). Allowed values: today | 7d | 30d | all | custom.

For custom, set the section(s) to 'custom' and supply customFrom & customTo (enable those two params).

Auth: requires an Owner or Admin Bearer token ({{token}}, set automatically by '01 - Auth > Login'). BusinessId is read from the token, so it is NOT passed as a parameter.

NOTE: log in as an OWNER (Owners carry a businessId). If you get 400 'BusinessId not found in token', your token has no business linked.

query.description: Applies the custom window to every section.

request.description: Same overview endpoint, demonstrating a custom date range across all sections. Change the dates to your data window. Requires an Owner Bearer token.
